resources.string: Shows the Hushtype bubble when you\'re typing and types what you dictate into the text field. Hushtype reads the text around your cursor only to polish your dictation and learn words you correct. It never collects or shares what\'s on your screen.
Dictate into any app with a floating bubble
Shown while Hushtype is using the microphone.
The microphone is on only while you dictate.
